about: which knob combinations build, per phone, and the Apple guideline limits every build is checked against. the case source reads the knob defaults here and asserts the same rules; ./build skips what these rules out and fails on anything else. ADG = Accessory Design Guidelines (extract/pdf/adg.pdf).

KEYS.values: button names; names a phone lacks are dropped

CLOSED.values: button names, none shared with KEYS

BACK_BAND.values: null (full back) or mm of back kept round the edge

COUPON.values: null or mm of each edge kept round the bottom-right corner

combinations.text: The slider needs the fitted camera ring; it slides over that window.
combinations.why: the slider covers a fitted window

combinations.text: The slider and MagSafe don't mix: the rails run down to y -52 and the charger's top edge sits at -45.
combinations.why: slider rails reach y -52, a charger's top edge is at -45

combinations.text: MagSafe needs the full back, since the magnets and the charger both sit on it.
combinations.why: magnets and the charger need the full back

combinations.text: A back plate needs a banded back to sit in.
combinations.why: the plate sits in a banded back

combinations.text: Keys need side walls, so they don't work with corner-only walls.
combinations.why: corner walls leave no wall for a key

combinations.text: A button is either a key or closed over, never both.
combinations.why: a button is either a key or covered

phones.text: Phones whose sheet has no corner profile can't be built.
phones.test: ref/iphone/sizes.json entry has a corner list (or a full spec)

phones.text: Phones with a full-width camera plateau need the universal camera window.
phones.why: full-width camera plateau, use CAMERA universal
phones.test: sizes.json camera plateau is not a bounded outline

phones.text: The slider needs room for its right rail beside the camera.
phones.why: right rail falls off the case
phones.test: slider right edge + SL_CLR + RAIL_W <= W + CLEAR + WALL, the rails clear of every lens and flash cone at their depth

phones.text: The cigarette clip needs a phone long enough to hold it.
phones.why: cigarette clip runs off the bottom

phones.text: The universal window only works when the camera sits within 48 mm of the top.
phones.why: camera reaches past the universal window

limits.text: Any exposed glass stays at least 0.85 mm, ideally 1.0, off a flat table; the rim and camera ring stand 1.0 proud.
limits.rule: exposed glass to any flat surface the case rests on
limits.case: GLASS_GAP 1.0; rim PROUD 1.0 over the front glass, camera ring 1.0 past the lens cover
limits.checked: check(): front glass, lens cover and back glass points against the convex hull, every build

limits.text: The back of the case is 2.0 mm thick, under the 2.1 each phone sheet allows (5.0 on the SE).
limits.rule: case thickness on the back of the phone

limits.text: The bottom wall is 1.8 mm, the most docks and cables allow.
limits.rule: case wall below the phone, for docks and cables

limits.text: MagSafe magnets sit 0.85 mm from the outside face at most.
limits.rule: MagSafe magnet to the case outside
limits.case: MS_FLOOR 0.85, magnet 0.55 thick, 0.55 from the device

limits.text: Every lens and flash light cone is cut clear, with the fit clearance added.
limits.rule: lens and flash light cones clear of the case
limits.source: ADG 5.7.1 and each sheet's keepout cones
limits.case: every cone cut through the case, grown by CLEAR for the phone's shift
limits.checked: the cut is part of every build

limits.text: The USB-C connector keepout is cut through the bottom wall, with the fit clearance added.
limits.rule: USB-C recommended connector keepout, flush to the product surface, 14.0 outward
limits.case: obround keepout grown by CLEAR, through the bottom wall
limits.checked: the cut is part of every build

limits.text: Speaker and mic openings reach 2.0 mm past the port, with a 45 degree chamfer outside and a 0.6 mm straight land.
limits.case: PORT_OFFSET 2.0 past the port edge, 45 deg outside chamfer, PORT_LAND 0.6 straight wall (1.5 max)
limits.checked: the cut is part of every build

limits.text: The front rim reaches 0.5 mm over the phone's rolled edge: more than the 0.25 clearance so it holds the phone, and short of the glass edge at 1.05.
limits.rule: rim lip over the rolled front edge clear of the glass edge
limits.case: LIP 0.5, and LIP > CLEAR so the phone is retained
